ValidationRule.description: Sent invoices must pass an audit mixing dates, strings, money math, picklist counts and email shape.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Sent'), OR( ISBLANK(Billing_Email__c), FIND('@', BLANKVALUE(Billing_Email__c, 'x')) = 0, AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Due_Date__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Issue_Date__c)), Due_Date__c - Issue_Date__c > 90), AND(NULLVALUE(Line_Count__c, 0) > 0, ROUND(NULLVALUE(Amount__c, 0) / NULLVALUE(Line_Count__c, 1), 0) < 1), AND(MOD(DAY(NULLVALUE(Issue_Date__c, TODAY())), 7) = 0, PICKLISTCOUNT(Payment_Methods__c) = 0), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Ref_Hash__c)), NOT(REGEX(Ref_Hash__c, '[a-f0-9]{8,40}'))) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Sent invoice failed the billing audit.
